scholarships.name: Students must open their own Finnish bank accounts to receive the scholarships.
scholarships.description: Bank account information needs to be filled on a separate e-form/query, sent by the scholarship team, by the end of November. We recommend opening your own account as soon as you have arrived to Finland and registered at the DVV. The scholarship payments cannot be made to anyone else's account.
